title: Chapter 453 Integrating The South
content:
Chapter 453 Integrating The South

However, the mood of everyone watching the show didn't last long. One month after Zhong Yu led the army to set off, because of Daming's dilapidated state, it was easy to attack the imperial capital of the Ming Dynasty and surrounded the entire imperial capital.

At this moment of life and death, even if the founding ancestor of the Ming Dynasty wanted to let the descendants solve it by themselves, he still couldn't stand by and had to take action.

It's a pity that just as the Taizu was full of confidence, he thought that as long as he made a move, the enemy on the opposite side would be reduced to ashes in an instant.

At this time, Zhong Yu stepped forward.

The confident Taizu of the Ming Dynasty just appeared in the sky above the imperial capital, which brought a great sense of oppression to the already strong morale and strength of the imperial army outside the city.

Even these troops have the feeling that as long as this continues, they will die suddenly because they cannot bear the coercion of the angels.

However, at the moment when the Taizu of the Ming Dynasty appeared, Zhong Yu also made a move.

From the avenue to the simplicity.

Whether it is supernatural powers, spells, or various techniques, they are nothing but the use of Tao.

And these uses have reached the last step, but they are all simple and can't be simpler, and even seem to be not much different from ordinary people's behavior.

Therefore, Zhong Yu, who has become enlightened, stretched out a hand.

These hands don't look fancy, they just stretch out slowly, as if they are making something.

It may look slow at first glance, but in fact the speed has reached the limit, and with a random grab, it is like a seal between heaven and earth, and boundless pressure rushes towards the place where it is caught.

And the Taizu of the Ming Dynasty, who was in this vortex, was the first to bear the brunt of the death crisis contained in these hands, so he didn't dare to keep his hands anymore, and exploded with his most powerful strength to fight against this giant hand stand up.

Guo Daming Taizu tried his best and exhausted all kinds of magical powers, but it was still difficult to resist this ordinary grab.

Ever since, the majestic celestial being, the supreme celestial being, the incomparably noble Ming Taizu, was caught by Zhong Yushang like an ant.

It seems unbelievable, both are masters of the same level, how could it be possible that Ming Taizu lost so quickly and easily.

But in fact, there is such a result, and it is reasonable.

As a member of the same group, although Zhong Yu has just stepped into the eighth level, he has accumulated a lot of knowledge. Although he is only at the beginning of the eighth level, he is already equivalent to the late eighth level or even the peak, and his strength is far beyond the ordinary eighth level.

However, the Taizu of the Ming Dynasty had exhausted his potential and spent a long time in the realm of celestial beings. He was still only a low-level celestial being, and his own combat power and supernatural powers were mediocre, and he was at the bottom of the eighth rank.

From the point of view of cultivation base, Zhong Yu is more than ten times better than the Great Ming Taizu, the two cannot be compared.

Besides, Zhong Yu's unremarkable grab just now looks ordinary, but it actually contains Zhong Yu's entire understanding of Tao. It seems casual under the first grasp, but in fact it is going all out and fighting with full strength.

Caught off guard, the Ming Taizu, who didn't take it seriously, had no time to react, and it was only natural that he was easily captured.

After taking down Da Ming Tai Zu, Zhong Yu threatened him a lot, and finally Da Ming Tai Zu did not dare to bear the threat of death and chose to surrender.

As a Celestial Immortal, he has a full lifespan of ten thousand years, and now more than a thousand years have passed. For his wonderful life, it is just the beginning. How could he easily abandon his present glory, wealth and power, and choose to die generously.

Therefore, Yuguo under Zhong Yu's command officially had a heavenly fairy join on this day, and it has the aura of a powerful country.

The Taizu of Ming Dynasty, Zhong Yushun, was forced to surrender. Dao consolidated the territory of the central part of the Ming Dynasty. As for the Jin Empire in the north, Zhong Yu chose not to touch it for the time being.

It's not that Da Jin's strength is too strong, so strong that Zhong Yu dare not spy on him.

It's because in the north of the Great Jin Dynasty, the current situation is unpredictable and unpredictable, and there are murderous opportunities everywhere.

Driven by the decline of human luck, the Tang Empire in the south launched an extremely tragic life-and-death battle with the powerhouses of the southern vassal states. As the overlord in the north, the Han Empire was not spared either.

And because this disaster came later than the Tang Empire, it is now at its most intense moment.

The powerhouses of the eighth rank of the Han Empire are constantly fighting with the powerhouses of neighboring countries, and they are terribly involved with each other. Countless civilians have been implicated by this and have suffered misfortune.

Even the eighth-level celestial beings lost seven or eight people, and the situation became more and more unmanageable as the anger grew.

Under such circumstances, the entire north has become a powder keg, and any external force that wants to intervene in it will accelerate its detonation.

Although Zhong Yu is confident that his own strength is strong, even if he intervenes, he will be able to retreat unscathed. But under such circumstances, it is inevitable that the territory under Zhong Yu's command will be affected, and there is no guarantee that Zhong Yu will suffer some injuries and cause unnecessary changes.

So Zhong Yu wisely chose to avoid it, not planning to intervene in it.

The north is just the land of the five provinces of the Ming Dynasty, while the south has the vast territory left over from the collapse of the Ming Dynasty. There are also the remaining three empires, as well as several other empires that have perished, waiting for Zhong Yu to conquer.

Compared with the north and south where the strength is still at its peak, after repeated battles, the strength has been greatly reduced, and there are only five angels left. For Zhong Yu, it is easy to push horizontally.

In this case, how to choose is naturally clear at a glance.

Therefore, before the news of the surrender of the Heavenly Immortal Taizu of the Ming Dynasty spread, Zhong Yu personally rushed to Fangguo in the southeast region. Fang Guo.

Fang Guo's Taizu said before that he was a person with a weak personality, maybe he couldn't be said to have a weak personality, after all, to be able to become a celestial being, there are some methods, at least killing and decisiveness is essential.

It should be said that he understood the practice and understood the general trend. Knowing that there was nothing to be done, the rational Taizu Fang Guo did not choose to resist stubbornly, but chose to surrender just like the Taizu of the Ming Dynasty.

At this moment, with Zhong Yu's subordinates and himself, there are three gods.

This kind of strength is more than enough to completely crush the five angels in the entire southern region.

After March, Zhong Yu visited the Three Kingdoms one after another. Among them, the Taizus of the two countries refused to surrender and were directly beheaded by Zhong Yu's sword. The remaining Taizu and the two immortals who knew the current affairs chose to surrender.

Since then, the southern border of the human race in the Liaozhai world was truly unified for the first time, and a very young empire, Yuguo, rose up.

The book is almost finished, probably in a day or two.
